description: On a new ACCDB database with W(ID LONG primary key, T TEXT(255), M MEMO), 10 rows are written by a DAO dynaset AddNew, T and M Field.Value puts of the BSTR, and Update: ID 1 fffe, ID 2 fffe-a, ID 3 a-fffe, ID 4 a-fffe-b, ID 5 fffe-fffe, ID 6 ffff, ID 7 a-ffff-b, ID 8 feff, ID 9 fffd, ID 10 plain. After closing and reopening read-only, asks what a snapshot of SELECT ID, T, M, Len(T), Len(M), AscW(Mid(T,1,1)), AscW(Mid(T,2,1)), AscW(Mid(M,1,1)), AscW(Mid(M,2,1)) returns for each row.
retentionNote: Designed r-text-fffe probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.

question.description: On a new ACCDB database with W(ID LONG primary key, T TEXT(255), M MEMO), 10 rows are written by a DAO dynaset AddNew, T and M Field.Value puts of the BSTR, and Update: ID 1 fffe, ID 2 fffe-a, ID 3 a-fffe, ID 4 a-fffe-b, ID 5 fffe-fffe, ID 6 ffff, ID 7 a-ffff-b, ID 8 feff, ID 9 fffd, ID 10 plain. After closing and reopening read-only, asks what a snapshot of SELECT ID, T, M, Len(T), Len(M), AscW(Mid(T,1,1)), AscW(Mid(T,2,1)), AscW(Mid(M,1,1)), AscW(Mid(M,2,1)) returns for each row.

args.text: CREATE TABLE W (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_W PRIMARY KEY, T TEXT(255), M MEMO)
SELECT ID, T, M, Len(T) AS LT, Len(M) AS LM, AscW(Mid(T,1,1)) AS T1, AscW(Mid(T,2,1)) AS T2, AscW(Mid(M,1,1)) AS M1, AscW(Mid(M,2,1)) AS M2 FROM W ORDER BY ID
